name: plot_ppi_network
description: Fetch protein-protein interactions from STRING and draw a network graph using networkx + matplotlib. Returns a PNG image of the interaction network with edge weights showing confidence scores.

parameters.species: int — NCBI taxonomy ID (default 9606 for human)
parameters.min_score: int — minimum STRING confidence 0-1000 (default 700 = high confidence)

returns: dict with n_interactions, top_interactors, output_files (PNG path)
